description: pH calculator — pH, pOH, [H3O+] and [OH-] for strong/weak acids and bases (exact quadratic, water autoionization for very dilute solutions), buffers (Henderson-Hasselbalch via acid_conc + base_conc) or a plain pH conversion (ph=). Built-in pKa/pKb table for ~50 common solutes (acetic acid, HCl, NaOH, ammonia, citric acid...); or pass type=strong-acid|strong-base|weak-acid|weak-base with pka/ka/pkb/kb. Params concentration= (mol/L), solute=. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: chem_ph
